title: Lazar named element 115 as fuel in 1989, before its 2003 synthesis

tellings.quote: Lazar described element 115 as the fuel source for the craft's propulsion system. [music] Mind you, this was in 1989, before element 115 had ever been synthesized [music] or named.

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, says that Bob Lazar, a man who claims he worked on alien craft at a secret Nevada site called S4, described element 115, a very heavy chemical element, as the fuel for the craft's propulsion back in 1989. Michels stresses that this was before element 115 had ever been made in a lab or given a name, which happened in 2003. If true, it would suggest Lazar knew something he could not have learned from public science.
